snippet.title: Splatoon Raiders – Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
The Splatoon Raiders game is available now only on the Nintendo Switch 2 system: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/splatoon-raiders-switch-2/?utm_source=SW-AA&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=S1028-01&utm_id=S1028-01

On the Spirhalite Islands…treasure is yours for the taking. Enemies will get in your way…but you’ve got the tools to deal with them.

There are all sorts of strange environments…and the deeper you go, the more treasure you’ll find. What else lies below the surface?

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
